result:
REST: simpler, cache-friendly, mature tooling. Good for standard CRUD, stable resources. Downside: over/under-fetching, many endpoints, versioning pain.

GraphQL: flexible queries, single endpoint, strong schema, great for complex clients/mobile. Downside: harder caching, query complexity/security risks, more server work, steeper ops/debugging.

Rule:  
- Simple/public/resource API -> REST.  
- Many clients needing different data shapes -> GraphQL.
